name: Elder Rowan
title: Keeper of the Waking Ring
examine: Has greeted every waker for forty years. Remembers most of their names.
lines: The Ring was warm this morning. That usually means one of you is coming.
Dawnmead asks nothing of you but a kind word on your way through.
Forty years of wakers, and not one of them stayed. That's as it should be.
